Next, unseal: vault.bin contains "VAULT v3 id=vlt-1122a4\n" + base64. v3 sealing: base64 of the byte sequence after XOR, but the byte sequence after XOR is reversed before base64. So to unseal: base64 decode, reverse the byte sequence, then XOR with the repeating key.

import base64
data = open("/home/agent/ctf/vault.bin","rb").read()
b64 = data.split(b"\n",1)[1].strip()
raw = base64.b64decode(b64)
key = bytes.fromhex("5602480cddd3332a")
# v3: reversed before base64 -> undo: reverse, then XOR
pt = bytes(b ^ key[i % len(key)] for i,b in enumerate(raw[::-1]))
print("reversed-first:", pt)
# try the other order just in case
pt2 = bytes(b ^ key[i % len(key)] for i,b in enumerate(raw))
print("xor-first:", pt2)
EOF
